svg.title: BegaIA Operating Model — View D — INTERNAL
svg.desc: Architectural view with exactly two systems. The Product System supports guest interaction through a conversational runtime and hotel operations through an abstract human-supervision surface. The guest uses the conversational runtime, while hotel reception uses and supervises the human-operations surface. Separately, the Human Authority in the Operating Model System governs product evolution from outside the request path. A relational change-governance interface contains a controlled hito, Runtime Map V1, and product change evidence; hotel reception and Human Authority are distinct human roles.

g.text: BegaIA Operating Model — View D — INTERNAL
BegaIA atiende al huésped y habilita operación hotelera supervisada. El Operating Model gobierna cómo BegaIA puede evolucionar.

g.aria-label: The Product System contains the guest-interaction conversational runtime and an abstract hotel-operations surface for human-assisted supervision.
g.text: Product execution · guest interaction + hotel-assisted operation
Relational band · not a third system

g.aria-label: External actors: guest and hotel operator
Hotel reception and operations actor that uses and supervises the Product System
Assisted operation and human supervision: review, confirmation, and intervention when appropriate

g.text: Operating Model System is outside the conversational runtime.
Runtime Map represents; it does not execute.
Recepción / Operación hotelera usa y supervisa el producto; no es Autoridad Humana del Operating Model.
